mechanism: Indomethacin may increase perphenazine levels through CYP450 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while both drugs increase CNS depression and anticholinergic effects; perphenazine may increase NSAID-induced GI ulceration risk.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, anticholinergic effects, and GI symptoms; consider alternative NSAID or monitor closely if combination necessary; ensure adequate GI protection.
